name: Gifts From God
overview: Scripture reveals that all gifts from God, both spiritual and temporal, are expressions of His providence and grace. The natural cycles of seedtime and harvest, seasons, and day and night continue by His design (Genesis 8:22), providing sustenance through rain and fruitful seasons (Leviticus 26:4-5). God grants peace and safety to His people as part of His blessings (Leviticus 26:6), and He empowers us to obtain wealth to fulfill His covenant purposes (Deuteronomy 8:18). These gifts remind us to depend on and remember the Lord as the ultimate source of all provision (Genesis 27:28).
